# Breakra

> The API safety layer for developers and AI agents. Catch breaking API changes before they ship: compare two OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 contracts (JSON or YAML) and get a safe/review/block verdict, evidence and a recommended fix for every finding. Deterministic. Free locally (npm CLI + MCP server) or hosted at $0.02 USDC per check via x402 on Base. It checks API contract compatibility; it is not a security vulnerability scanner.

## Use it
- [Agent guide (skill.md)](https://breakra.dev/skill.md): when to call, how to pay safely, how to read results
- [API contract (openapi.json)](https://breakra.dev/openapi.json): the hosted endpoint, OpenAPI 3.1
- CLI: `npx -y breakra check old.yaml new.yaml` (exit 0 ok, 1 at or above --fail-on, 2 error = unchecked)
- MCP: `npx -y breakra mcp` (tool: check_openapi_change)
